spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: label
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: A human-readable label for this level (e.g. 'bin20').

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: bin_size
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The edge length of one pixel of this level in base pixel units. Must appear in the parent's bin_sizes.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: pixel_size_x
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The physical size of one pixel of this level in x. Equal to bin_size times the parent's base_pixel_size_x.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: pixel_size_y
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The physical size of one pixel of this level in y.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: pixel_size_units
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The units of pixel_size_x and pixel_size_y.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_order
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The order of the dimensions, following the imageStack_parameters convention; G denotes the gene dimension.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_labels
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The labels of each dimension as a comma-separated list, in dimension_order.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_size
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The length of each dimension in dimension_order for the whole level, not per tile.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_scale
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The scale of each dimension in dimension_order, in dimension_scale_units.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: dimension_scale_units
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The units of each dimension as a comma-separated list, in dimension_order.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: tile_size_x_bins
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The width of one tile in pixels of THIS level. Edge tiles may be partially filled.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: tile_size_y_bins
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The height of one tile in pixels of THIS level.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: n_tiles_stored
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The number of tile files written. May be less than tile_rows*tile_columns because empty tiles are omitted; use ndi.document/current_file_list to discover which exist.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_gene_index
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: Integer type of the gene_index array. Values index rows of the geneList the parent depends on.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_count
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: Integer type of the count array.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_offset
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: Integer type of the offset (row pointer) array.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: data_type_coordinate
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: Integer type of the tile-local x and y coordinate arrays.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: tile_compression
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: Compression applied to each tile file as a whole: 'none' or 'gzip'.

spatialGeneExpressionTiles.name: tile_format_version
spatialGeneExpressionTiles.documentation: The version of the tile binary layout. See spatialGeneExpressionTiles.md.
